title: SoTA pack: Agent Memory Architecture
summary: Maintained synthesis of competing agent-memory traditions as of 2026-06-08: decay/refresh is empirically mandatory (Memora), memory should separate evidence from inference (Hindsight), vector similarity is not identity (KAG), and extracted-memory systems trade recall for cost (Mem0).
invalidationTests: A newer benchmark refutes Memora's invalid-memory-reuse finding
A system shows pure-vector retrieval matching KAG on temporal/numeric/expert-rule tasks

title: Decision: adopt FPF Evidence Memory (+8 fixes), keep spec runtime canonical
summary: ADR-backing card. fpf-memory stays vectorless/deterministic; the new research-memory plane is additive. Tool family must avoid the blocked fpf_memory namespace. Grounded in FPF A.7/G.6/B.3.4/B.4/G.11.
invalidationTests: Repo lifts the fpf_memory legacy block after the 2026-06-30 review
